create_text_shards_from_file: create text file shards from a single CSV or TSV file using make_text_file_shards with chunk strategy
create_chunk_shards_for_parallel_process: create chunk-based shards from a large text file split into N contiguous byte ranges for parallel workers
create_round_robin_shards: create round-robin shards from a text file where each shard gets every Nth line distributed across workers
create_sorted_shards_by_column: create sorted text shards by a column value using make_sorted_text_shards with deduplication support
merge_shard_outputs: merge multiple shard output files back into a single file ordered by shard index using merge_shards
